te: Queen consort Gertrude of Merania is assassinated by a group of Hungarian lords.
dz: 梅拉尼亚王后王后格特鲁德被一群匈牙利领主所刺杀.
de: Queen consort Gertrude of Merania is assassinated by a group of Hungarian lords.

t: 英格兰国王亨利一世在廷切布雷战役中击败了弟弟罗伯特·库尔特斯.
te: King Henry I of England defeats his brother Robert Curthose at the Battle of Tinchebray.
dz: 英格兰国王亨利一世在廷切布雷战役中击败了弟弟罗伯特·库尔特斯.
de: King Henry I of England defeats his brother Robert Curthose at the Battle of Tinchebray.

t: 征服者威廉在英格兰登陆,开始了诺曼人的征服.
te: William the Conqueror lands in England, beginning the Norman conquest.
dz: 征服者威廉在英格兰登陆,开始了诺曼人的征服.
de: William the Conqueror lands in England, beginning the Norman conquest.

t: 波列斯劳斯二世,波希米亚公爵,杀死了敌对的斯拉夫尼克王朝的大部分成员.
te: Boleslaus II, Duke of Bohemia, kills most members of the rival Slavník dynasty.
dz: 波列斯劳斯二世,波希米亚公爵,杀死了敌对的斯拉夫尼克王朝的大部分成员.
de: Boleslaus II, Duke of Bohemia, kills most members of the rival Slavník dynasty.

t: 波希米亚的温塞斯劳斯一世公爵被他弟弟博莱斯劳斯一世所领导的贵族集团所谋杀,博莱斯劳斯一世继位.
te: Duke Wenceslaus I of Bohemia is murdered by a group of nobles led by his brother Boleslaus I, who succeeds him.
dz: 波希米亚的温塞斯劳斯一世公爵被他弟弟博莱斯劳斯一世所领导的贵族集团所谋杀,博莱斯劳斯一世继位.
de: Duke Wenceslaus I of Bohemia is murdered by a group of nobles led by his brother Boleslaus I, who succeeds him.

t: 罗马篡位者普罗克皮乌斯贿赂了从君士坦丁堡经过的两个军团,并宣布自己为皇帝.
te: Roman usurper Procopius bribes two legions passing by Constantinople, and proclaims himself emperor.
dz: 罗马篡位者普罗克皮乌斯贿赂了从君士坦丁堡经过的两个军团,并宣布自己为皇帝.
de: Roman usurper Procopius bribes two legions passing by Constantinople, and proclaims himself emperor.

t: 君士坦提乌斯二世击败了篡位者马格能提乌斯.
te: Constantius II defeats the usurper Magnentius.
dz: 君士坦提乌斯二世击败了篡位者马格能提乌斯.
de: Constantius II defeats the usurper Magnentius.

t: 教宗庞蒂安辞职. 他和罗马的希波利图斯一起被放逐到撒丁岛的矿场.
te: Pope Pontian resigns. He is exiled to the mines of Sardinia, along with Hippolytus of Rome.
dz: 教宗庞蒂安辞职. 他和罗马的希波利图斯一起被放逐到撒丁岛的矿场.
de: Pope Pontian resigns. He is exiled to the mines of Sardinia, along with Hippolytus of Rome.

t: 庞贝一到埃及就从佩卢西姆上岸,然后被波勒米十三世国王下令暗杀.
te: Pompey disembarks at Pelusium upon arriving in Egypt, whereupon he is assassinated by order of King Ptolemy XIII.
dz: 庞贝一到埃及就从佩卢西姆上岸,然后被波勒米十三世国王下令暗杀.
de: Pompey disembarks at Pelusium upon arriving in Egypt, whereupon he is assassinated by order of King Ptolemy XIII.
